title: The Draft Prospect Thanksgiving Plate
parts:
🦃 The Draft Prospect Thanksgiving Plate

Nine dishes, nine 2027 NFL Draft prospects from the Alpha Draft Signal. Every pairing comes with a real stat, because this table doesn't serve vibes.

Ranks: among draft-eligible players, board thru Wk 11. Stats thru Week 12.

TURKEY: Jeremiah Smith, WR1, Ohio State
The centerpiece. 1,482 yards, 17 TD, 44.3% of Ohio State's receiving yards. Everything else is a side.

STUFFING: Dylan Riley, RB14, Boise State
Does a bit of everything: 57.0% of Boise State's rushing yards, plus 317 receiving.

MASHED POTATOES: DeSean Bishop, RB8, Tennessee
Reliable, and there's a mountain of it: 248 carries, 50.8% of Tennessee's.

GRAVY: Darian Mensah, QB6, Miami
Makes the whole plate better: 9.4 yards per attempt, 29 TD to 4 INT. Preseason, he was QB52.

CRANBERRY SAUCE: Isaac Brown, RB5, Louisville
Polarizing. Games from 11 rushing yards to 235, but 6.95 a carry vs 5.2 for the rest of Louisville.

GREEN BEAN CASSEROLE: Wyatt Young, WR4, Oklahoma State
Underrated 3-star: 835 yards, 22.9% of OK State's receiving yards.

DINNER ROLLS: Luke Reynolds, TE1, Virginia Tech
Always there: a catch in all 11 games, 21.1% of VT's receiving yards.

PUMPKIN PIE: J'Koby Williams, RB1, Texas Tech
Late riser: preseason RB22, now RB1. 7.5 a carry vs 3.9 for the rest of the team. On tonight vs TCU.

LEFTOVERS: Jadan Baugh, RB2, Florida
Still a junior, and just as good the next day: 16 rushing TD on 45.7% of Florida's carries.

That's my plate.

What's on yours? Give me a dish and the 2027 draft prospect who belongs on it.
